# @agents-js/a2ui-types

> Thin re-export layer over @a2ui/web_core v0.9 plus a custom catalog for agents-js.

## Installation

```sh
bun add @agents-js/a2ui-types
```

### Types

### Constants

- **`A2UI_META_KEY`** — The `_meta` field key on an ACP `ToolCallContent` that carries an A2UI lifecycle message. ACP v0.18 does not standardize a discriminator for A2UI payloads; the `_meta.a2ui_message` convention is th...
- **`A2UI_SURFACE_EVENT_NAME`** — The AG-UI `CUSTOM` event `name` used when the gateway forwards an `ACPSessionEvent { type: "surface_event" }` onto the wire. Namespaced under `agents-js.*` for collision resistance.
- **`A2UI_WS_FRAME_TYPE`** — Discriminator for the WS-bridge server frame that carries a verbatim `A2uiMessage` from the gateway to a browser host. Used by both the gateway (`apps/internal-gateway/ws-bridge.ts`) and the browse...
- **`ACP_CATALOG_ID`** — Stable identifier for the ACP custom catalog.
- **`ACP_COMPONENT_APIS`** — Ordered list of all ACP component APIs. Consumers can iterate this to register renderers for every ACP component.
- **`AcpCatalog`** — ACP custom catalog instance. Pass alongside the basic catalog to a `MessageProcessor`: ```ts import { BasicCatalog } from "/web_core/v0_9/basic_catalog"; import { MessageProcessor } from "/web_core...
- **`AuthSelectorApi`** — Selector for an authentication method or session.
- **`ChatAppApi`** — Top-level chat surface: wraps transcript + prompt input + status bar.
- **`CodeBlockApi`** — Fenced-code block with optional language hint.
- **`ConnectDialogApi`** — Connection dialog for choosing an A2A endpoint/runtime.
- **`DebugPanelApi`** — Debug panel (log transports, span inspector). Host-only diagnostic surface.
- **`ElicitationFormApi`** — Structured elicitation form — a sequence of labelled fields with a submit action.
- **`MessageApi`** — A single chat message (user / agent / system).
- **`ModelSelectorApi`** — Selector for the underlying language model.
- **`PermissionModalApi`** — Modal asking the user to approve or deny a sensitive operation.
- **`PermissionModeSelectorApi`** — Selector for the active permission mode (ask / acceptEdits / bypass / plan).
- **`PromptInputApi`** — Multi-line prompt input with submit action.
- **`StatusBarApi`** — Persistent status bar at the bottom of a chat surface.
- **`StreamingTextApi`** — Token-stream text surface (partial updates).
- **`TranscriptApi`** — Scrollable message list for an ACP session.
- **`WriteGateModalApi`** — Modal shown when a write operation hits the write-gate policy.
